create_StreamDataset: create a StreamDataset to prepare BPTT batches from tokenized sentences for language model training
create_Dataset: create a Dataset to manage tokenized sentences with batching, filtering, and iterator support
create_ParallelDataset: create a ParallelDataset to manage paired source-target sentence tensors for translation or span prediction tasks
get_iterator_Dataset: get a batched sentences iterator from a Dataset with optional shuffling and size grouping
select_data_Dataset: select a subset of sentences from a Dataset by index range for train-validation splitting
